name: us1-adopt-team-managed
description: 003 US1 (T050): the SAME labelled corpus served by a TEAM-MANAGED project. Adoption reads labels, project, parent and the identity property, and writes only the identity property — it asserts nothing about issue types, statuses, transitions, priorities or custom fields, so it carries no project-style branch and must bind and stamp identically to the company-managed run (NFR-5, Principle VII). Diffing this capture against us1-adopt-hierarchy proves it.
